title: Chapter 3: The First Step
paragraphs: Arthur placed his hand on the obsidian stele. A surge of memory fragments poured directly into his consciousness.
Techniques that had been lost during the Great Celestial War thousands of years ago unfolded in his mind like a lotus blooming at midnight.
With a grin, Arthur channeled his newly awakened qi. The days of being stepped on by inner disciples were officially over.
